lines: Duplication is the secret to real, lasting income. Let's learn how to copy yourself.
Your job as a sponsor is simple: get your new person to their first sale, fast.
A quick first win creates belief, and belief creates momentum that lasts.
Don't do it for them. Do it with them, so they learn to do it without you.
Teach the exact same simple steps you learned — list, invite, present, follow up.
When your steps are simple enough to copy, your team grows on its own.
This is the power of duplication: you help a few, and they help a few, and it multiplies.
Aim to make yourself unnecessary. A leader who isn't needed has built something real.
Keep it simple, keep it duplicatable, and your organization will grow beyond you.
Finally, let's tie it together — how you rank up and earn the bonuses. Let's go.
